name: Create a Turnstile Widget
description: Create a Turnstile Widget Lists challenge widgets. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets
Lists challenge widgets.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); order (query); direction (query); filter (query) — Filter widgets by field using case-insensitive substring matching. Format: `field:value` Supported fields: - `name` - Filter by widget name (e.g., `filter=name:login-form`) - `sitekey` - Filter by sitekey (e.g., `filter=sitekey:0x4AAA`) Returns 400 Bad Request if the field is unsupported or format is invalid. An empty filter value returns all results.

name: Delete a Turnstile Widget
description: Delete a Turnstile Widget Destroy a Turnstile Widget. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets/{sitekey}

name: Turnstile Widget Details

name: Rotate Secret for a Turnstile Widget
description: Rotate Secret for a Turnstile Widget Generate a new secret key for this widget. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets/{sitekey}/rotate_secret
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets/{sitekey}/rotate_secret
Generate a new secret key for this widget. If `invalidate_immediately` is set to `false`, the previous secret remains valid for 2 hours. Note that secrets cannot be rotated again during the grace period.
Required: account_id (path); sitekey (path); body (body)

name: Update a Turnstile Widget
description: Update a Turnstile Widget Update the configuration of a widget. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets/{sitekey}
